# Mayfox Gold and Precious Metals Kenya

> Licensed Kenyan export agent arranging verified gold doré bars and nuggets from East and Central African sources, with independent assay, full export documentation and insured delivery to institutional buyers worldwide. Refined 995 and 999.9 product is delivered through partner refineries.

Mayfox Gold and Precious Metals Kenya operates from Rhapta Road, Westlands, Nairobi. We act as export agent for the buyer: we source from licensed East African cooperatives and aggregators, arrange independent assay, assemble the Kenyan export document set, and deliver insured air freight to the destination you nominate. We do not publish prices, premiums or treatment-and-refining charges — every consignment is valued on contained gold against an agreed benchmark, per mandate.

Contact: +254 754 979 755 (also WhatsApp) · sales@mayfox.co.ke · Mon–Sat, 08:00–20:00 EAT (UTC+3).
